cards.title: Your chat notes
cards.text: Maze 2.5x bigger, camera further out, auto fire, fewer enemies, more shards, red health shards.
cards.why: Everything you wrote after the last deck. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details: Version 0.16.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it. Auto fire is a setting (on).

parts.title: 2.5x bigger
parts.text: Every 2x2 is now 5x5: corridors 20 to 40 cells wide, walls 10. The camera is further out (48 rows by default) and you see 70 cells.

parts.title: Auto fire
parts.text: Your weapon fires at the nearest enemy you can see. Spawn and Burst throw themselves. Dash dodges when something's about to touch you. Touch the fire stick to aim yourself.

parts.title: Beatable
parts.text: At most 24 wanderers; none come while 8 or more are near you; waves top out at 28; crowds shove you less, so you can push out of a dead end.

parts.title: More shards
parts.text: In most dead ends now, and at some corridor crossings.

parts.title: Red shards
parts.text: 7% of kills drop one (30% big ones, always the boss). Pulled in like XP, heals 15. New cards: Heal shards (+5 each) and a rare Regeneration.

parts.title: Laser start
parts.text: Points straight at your aim when you start firing, then turns slowly.
